purpose: Exploratory additional cohort after inspecting results from other datasets. Not an independent prespecified confirmation and not a replacement that erases Zhou2020.

dataset.subject_mapping: Analysis IDs 1-9 are raw GR 1-9; analysis IDs 10-18 are raw PAR 11-19.
dataset.session_definition: One recording day, pooling bar-task runs only; racing excluded.
dataset.protocol_heterogeneity: Session 1 is offline guided bar feedback; sessions 2-6 are online model-driven feedback. All historical sessions remain candidate sources, matching the existing latest-session design.

preprocessing.filter: fourth-order Butterworth, causal SOS, continuous within each run, zero initial state
preprocessing.short_trial_rule: Exclude task segments shorter than 512 samples; retain complete exclusion records. Do not exclude by correct/error terminal codes or by classification performance in this analysis. Task duration itself is determined by the original online decoder, so this is a duration-conditioned trial population.
preprocessing.population: Bar-task trials whose actual task duration is at least one second.
preprocessing.covariance: Channel-demeaned sample covariance, denominator 511, stored in microvolt squared.
preprocessing.unit_note: The original GDF has malformed physical bounds. The referenced MOABB loader treats MNE numerical EEG values as microvolts, multiplying by 1e-6 for volts. This cache retains those numerical values in microvolts; headers and amplitude summaries are audited.
preprocessing.difference_from_previous_cohorts: Task-onset one-second epochs and causal filtering prevent early-termination outcome signals entering these features. These choices are fixed before outcomes, not tuned for performance.

amendment_before_first_real_analysis.observation: The complete data-only audit found 6135 of 7200 trials eligible. Subject 18 session 5 retains class counts 16/6 and session 6 retains 12/7; all other subject/session cells meet the original minimum of 8 per class. No real classification or coverage result had been calculated.
amendment_before_first_real_analysis.change: Replace the operational per-class minimum of 8 by 4, so stratified half-splits retain at least two observations in each class on each side. All 18 subjects and all six sessions are retained.
amendment_before_first_real_analysis.unchanged: No change to trial eligibility, duration window, features, source/target roles, classifiers, alpha, bootstrap repetitions, split count, random seeds, comparisons, noninferiority margins, or complete reporting. This amendment is based only on data availability, not performance.

reporting.classifier: Unchanged train_eval_ts: training-only Riemannian reference, covariance shrinkage 0.05, tangent features, LSQR LDA with auto shrinkage.
reporting.target_only: Same classifier trained on labeled screening half, a labeled reference, not label-budget matched.
reporting.primary_comparison: Subject-averaged balanced accuracy: refinement minus all-source pooling; paired two-sided t interval and one-sided 95% lower bound, noninferiority margin 0.02. The 0.01 margin is sensitivity only.
reporting.secondary_comparison: Refinement minus MCS-style, paired subject-level interval. GR and PAR descriptive summaries, without selecting the better group.
reporting.coverage: Report component, contrast and joint empirical-reference coverage, oracle retention, exact recovery and retained fraction. This is resampling from empirical distributions, not known population truth.
reporting.retention: Full-target screening and split-specific screening reported separately.
reporting.completion: Report all 18 subjects. Data or computation failures must be reported and resolved, never omitted based on outcomes. Retain every result regardless of sign.
